title.narrative: MultiDonor Trust Fund for the Global Financing Facility (GFF) in Support of Every Woman Every Child

description.narrative: "The overarching development objective of the TF is improved outcomes for MDGs 4 & 5, namely Reduction of Infant Mortality and Improvement of Maternal Health. The TF supports progress towards this objective thru the piloting of an innovative financing mechanism in 4-6 countries. The results of this pilot, along with the knowledge generated on good design and implementation strategies for this mechanism, will provide a platform for scaling up this kind of financing as an option for future funding in this area. It is expected that the mechanism, if shown to be successful, will attract other development partners' contributions and allow them to be channeled in a harmonized way at the country level. The goals of the TF are to: (1) improve MDG4 and 5 results in 4-6 pilot countries through application of results-based financing(RBF) mechanism;(2) help assure sustained financing in these pilot countries; (3) generate new knowledge about effective design and implementation strategies for successful RBF interventions; and 4) develop a credible and viable platform for scaling up RBF through an IDA-friendly mechanism."
